title: Home
description: Is anything wrong, and where; the detail is in the rows below.

panels.title: Flight tracker
panels.description: How long it has been up, or in red, how long it has been down (looking back 7 days). Down means the public site does not answer with live data.

targets.expr: ((time() - max_over_time(timestamp((max(probe_success{job="integrations/blackbox/flight-tracker"}) or vector(0)) < 1)[7d:1m])) and on() ((max(probe_success{job="integrations/blackbox/flight-tracker"}) or vector(0)) == 1)) or ((time() - min_over_time(timestamp(max(probe_success{job="integrations/blackbox/flight-tracker"}))[7d:1m])) and on() ((max(probe_success{job="integrations/blackbox/flight-tracker"}) or vector(0)) == 1)) or -(time() - max_over_time(timestamp((max(probe_success{job="integrations/blackbox/flight-tracker"}) or vector(0)) == 1)[7d:1m])) or vector(-604800)

panels.title: Home Assistant
panels.description: How long it has been up, or in red, how long it has been down (looking back 7 days). Up means its container runs.

targets.expr: ((time() - max(max by (name) (container_start_time_seconds{job="docker",name=~"homeassistant"}))) and on() (count(max by (name) (container_start_time_seconds{job="docker",name=~"homeassistant"})) == 1)) or -(time() - min(max by (name) (last_over_time(container_last_seen{job="docker",name=~"homeassistant"}[7d])))) or vector(-604800)

panels.title: DNS and proxy
panels.description: How long it has been up, or in red, how long it has been down (looking back 7 days). The .internal names: up means both containers run.

targets.expr: ((time() - max(max by (name) (container_start_time_seconds{job="docker",name=~"internal-names-(dns|proxy)-1"}))) and on() (count(max by (name) (container_start_time_seconds{job="docker",name=~"internal-names-(dns|proxy)-1"})) == 2)) or -(time() - min(max by (name) (last_over_time(container_last_seen{job="docker",name=~"internal-names-(dns|proxy)-1"}[7d])))) or vector(-604800)

panels.title: Backup
panels.description: Time since the last good nightly backup; amber past 26 h, when the backup alert fires.

panels.title: Alerts
panels.description: Alert rules firing now; a rule with several firing series counts once.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Share of the CPU in use.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Share of memory in use; the memory alert fires past 90%.

panels.title: Swap
panels.description: Swap in use, holding pages.

panels.title: Disk
panels.description: Share of the root disk in use; the disk alert fires past 80%.

panels.title: Free
panels.description: Space free on the root disk; amber under 100 GB, where Beelink disk filling up fires (80% used).

panels.title: Backup
panels.description: The backup repository in R2; the alert fires past 5 GB, uploads stop at 8 GB.

panels.title: Free
panels.description: Room left under the 8 GB at which backup uploads stop; amber under 3 GB, where Backup storage nearly full fires (5 GB used).

panels.title: Who uses the box, last 24 hours
Memory by group
panels.description: The stack's top is the host's own figure in use. Monitoring is the observability stack; Apps every other container; System the rest.

panels.title: CPU by group, cores
panels.description: The stack's top is the host's own figure in use. Monitoring is the observability stack; Apps every other container; System the rest.

panels.title: Error lines per hour, by container
panels.description: Lines that log an error, a fatal or a Python exception. Alloy resends a container's recent lines when it restarts; this chart counts those twice (stats over a range cannot drop repeats first), the table below does not.

targets.expr: (i(error) or i(fatal) or i(panic) or i(crit) or i(critical) or i(exception) or i(limited)) (level:in(error, fatal, critical) or _msg:~`^.{0,40}\b(ERROR|FATAL|PANIC|CRITICAL)\b|(?i:level=(error|fatal|crit))|^(\w+\.)+[A-Z]\w*: |^[A-Z]\w*(Error|Exception): `) | stats by (container_name) count() as lines

panels.title: Most repeated error lines, last hour
panels.description: Numbers and ids show as #, so repeats of one error count together; each line is cut at 80 characters.

targets.expr: _time:1h (i(error) or i(fatal) or i(panic) or i(crit) or i(critical) or i(exception) or i(limited)) (level:in(error, fatal, critical) or _msg:~`^.{0,40}\b(ERROR|FATAL|PANIC|CRITICAL)\b|(?i:level=(error|fatal|crit))|^(\w+\.)+[A-Z]\w*: |^[A-Z]\w*(Error|Exception): `) | uniq by (_time, container_name, _msg) | replace_regexp ("^observability-|-1$", "") at container_name | replace_regexp (`\x1b\[[0-9;]*m|^\S*\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d[T ][0-9:.,]+\S*\s*`, "") at _msg | replace_regexp ("[0-9a-f]*[0-9][0-9a-f]*", "#") at _msg | extract_regexp `^(?P<line>.{0,80})` from _msg | stats by (container_name, line) count() as hits | sort by (hits desc) limit 20

panels.description: Each container's CPU use.

panels.title: Memory by container
panels.description: Each container's working set, the memory it cannot give back.

panels.title: Top 10 by CPU now, cores
panels.description: The busiest containers over the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Top 10 by memory now
panels.description: The containers holding the most memory.

panels.title: Traffic, bytes a second
panels.description: The host's wired network and Tailscale, in and out.

panels.title: Received by container, bytes a second
panels.description: What each container receives; Traffic shows the host's in and out.

panels.title: Network checks, a second
panels.description: Retried connection attempts, resets sent and connections dropped while queued: each climbs when something cannot connect.

panels.title: Last ok
panels.description: Time since the last good nightly backup; amber past 26 h.

panels.title: Verified
panels.description: Time since restic last read back every byte (weekly); amber past 8 days.

panels.title: Failed
panels.description: Time since a run last failed.

panels.title: Stored
panels.description: The repository's size; uploads stop at 8 GB.

panels.title: Stored over time
panels.description: The repository's size after each good run.

panels.title: Runs
panels.description: Each day's run in the time range (pick a longer one for more): how it ended, empty if it stopped before saying, when it started and finished, and how many deep checks read every byte back.

targets.expr: container_name:="backup" | uniq by (_time, _msg) | stats by (_time:1d) min(_time) as started, max(_msg) if (_msg:~"^backup (ok|FAILED|SKIPPED)") as result, max(_time) if (_msg:~"^backup (ok|FAILED|SKIPPED)") as finished, count() if (_msg:="deep check ok") as deep_checks | sort by (started desc)

panels.title: Alerts that fired
panels.description: Each rule that fired in the time range, first and last minute it fired, and its minutes firing; still firing if its last time is this minute.

panels.title: Rules firing, by hour
panels.description: Minutes each rule fired in each hour.
